Legal & Compliance

Accessibility Statement

Our commitment to Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act and WCAG 2.0 / 2.1 Level AA.

Our commitment

US Government Services LLC is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for all users, including people with disabilities. We strive to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) version 2.0 and 2.1, Level AA, as incorporated by reference into the Revised Section 508 Standards at 36 C.F.R. Part 1194.

Standards applied

  • Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, as amended (29 U.S.C. § 794d)
  • Federal Acquisition Regulation Subpart 39.2 — Section 508 deliverables
  • Revised Section 508 Standards (36 C.F.R. Part 1194), incorporating WCAG 2.0 Level AA Success Criteria
  • OMB Memorandum M-24-08 — Strengthening Digital Accessibility

Where we are today

This website was designed with accessibility in mind: clear color contrast in our primary palette, descriptive page titles and meta information, semantic HTML markup, keyboard-navigable interactive elements, and descriptive link text. We have not yet completed a third-party accessibility audit, and so we describe our posture as striving to conform to WCAG 2.0/2.1 Level AA rather than asserting full conformance.

Section 508 in our deliverables

When delivering federal contracts, US Government Services LLC commits to deliver all in-scope information and communication technology (ICT) in conformance with the Section 508 requirements applicable to the work. We will produce Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACR / VPAT 2.4 INT) for in-scope deliverables when required by the contracting officer.

Feedback & assistance

If you encounter an accessibility barrier on this website or in any communication from US Government Services LLC, please contact us so we can address it:

  • Email: John@usgovtservices.com
  • Phone: (703) 672-1844

We aim to respond to accessibility feedback within 5 business days.
